issues.text: For ORCH and CODE-DESIGNER: docs/design/V1-public-look.md 7.11 says the phone bar is 'fixed to the bottom of the window' and the code design (7.11 row of its phone block) says the same; the code now makes it position: sticky; bottom: 0 in the question wrap, so it is at the bottom of the window as before while the page scrolls and rests above the footer at the end of the page (T4 I1 named both 'space under the footer' and 'no bar over the footer'). I judged this inside the finding and the look's own rule of section 12 ('may cover the bottom of the page until the visitor scrolls'), not a departure: the first screens at 390x844 and 320x568 are byte-identical to the build, the bar and its sheet look the same. Visible differences: the page is about 85 px longer on a phone; on a window taller than the page the bar stands above the footer, not over it. The text of 7.11 (and 7.9 for the 360 edit) needs the edit 'sticky to the bottom'; if the gate reads it as a departure, the alternative is the fixed bar and a padding-bottom under the footer of the measured 85 px (a number the CSS cannot read), and I stop on that word.

REVIEWER L1 is closed for the focus (0 of 120 states) and not for the first scroll position without a focus: at 320x568 the lower 7-30 px of «‹ Назад» (ru 14, kk 7-30; none at 360x640 and 359x640 and 390x844) stand under the strip in 22 states until the visitor scrolls 30 px; the look 12 allows it. The scroll padding is a number (90 px plus the safe area, from the 84.8 of the look) because CSS cannot read the height of the strip; a custom property set from the page would need a setProperty beyond --tx in demo.js, which the strict list of public-pages.test.js (the only property demo.js may write is --tx) forbids, so it was not used. The rule covers every control of the question page below 760 px (the answer cards too, the kind of AP-014), not only «‹ Назад».

SEC L1 was closed in app/server/routes/demo.js (answer()), not in app/server/app.js, which the finding names: the mapping to demo_unavailable is the route's (design 4.7), and app.js stays free of demo paths. Another route that would return a body JSON.stringify cannot write still goes to onError as before; none exists. Design 4.7 needs a line: the answer body is written inside the mapping, and every text of the answer must be a string after the language is picked.

Beyond the shapes of SEC L2, the same check changes one answer that the reviewer noted as no finding (step-04b I4b): an intake that loadIntake accepts whose option is a string or an array (no label) gave the questionnaire 200 with an option without id and label; it is now 503 demo_unavailable, as the other broken shapes. No existing test expects the old answer (npm run check green). Named so that TEST-DESIGNER and the reviewers know.

Not covered by a deterministic row: the result route with an unwritable body (an id nested between 6 900 and 9 700 deep; the window depends on the stack of the machine). answer() serves both routes with the one code path; DM-6c holds the unwritable body through the questionnaire with a throwing toJSON, which is deterministic. The ids of a solution cannot carry such a value in a test because the engine reads them.

Evidence on scratch copies: the before copy is git archive of HEAD (the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-fix2) with the tests of this step copied in; the after copy is rsync of the working tree. On the before copy VB-4 fails only because an archive has no .git ('VB-4 needs app/ inside a git working tree'); it passes in the tree. The browser driver measured 120 states (3 windows plus 359 x ru, kk, en x light, dark x 5 questions): footer link under the bar 120 -> 0, focused control under the bar 22 -> 0.
